title: The Deep Cover
author: Wendell Almeida
blurb: Jonah Underhill, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, has spent twelve years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
